journey.title: Ticking a checkbox inside the preferences dialog keeps it open
journey.goal: Space ticks the checkbox and the dialog stays open

functionalJourney.title: Open and close preferences with the pointer
functionalJourney.goal: The dialog opens and the close button dismisses it

guards.title: Done closes the preferences dialog from the keyboard
guards.goal: Activating Done dismisses the dialog and focus returns to the trigger

attempts.failure: Expected ',' or ']' after array element in JSON at position 1209 (line 11 column 1)

plan.root_cause: The modal's click handler closes the modal for any click inside the overlay because the overlay has the close trigger attribute. When the checkbox receives a Space key press, it fires a click event that bubbles to the overlay, causing the modal to close before the checkbox can toggle.
plan.repair_strategy: Modify the onClick handler to ignore clicks that originate from inside the modal container (i.e., where the closest close-trigger element is the overlay but the event target is not the overlay). This allows the overlay background click to close, but preserves clicks on the modal content (including the checkbox) and the close button.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: The checkbox can be toggled via Space key while the dialog remains open, preserving keyboard operability and focus management per WCAG 2.1.1 and 4.1.2.
functional_risks: Minimal; the change only affects click handling for modals with the same structure. Could affect modals where the overlay is not the direct parent of the modal container, but the library's typical usage matches this pattern.
verification_requirements: The journey should pass: Space on checkbox toggles it, dialog stays open, form data includes "weekly", focus remains on checkbox.
